book.name: Matiu
book.title: Toto Thovuye Utuniye Matiu Le Rorori

content: Tha hu wovatharɨtharɨŋa ghamune
“Tha hu wovatharɨtharɨŋaŋgiya ghamune, ne iwaeŋge Loi i wovatharɨtharɨŋaŋga.
Loi le wovatharɨtharɨ weŋga ne i mboromboro weiye lemi wovatharɨtharɨ weŋgiya ghamunena. Lemi vakathako gharɨgharɨ weŋgi tembene i vakathava ŋgoreiye weŋga.
“Buda kaiwae u thuweya ŋuthuŋuthuna ghanuna e marae, ko iyemaeŋge ma u thuweya umbwana laghɨye iya ghen e maranɨna?
Thoŋgo umbwa laghɨye ina e maranɨna, ŋgoroŋgaeŋge na u dage weya ghanuna, ‘Ne ya woraŋgiya ŋuthuŋuthuna e maranɨna?’
Taukwana ghen! I viva wo u woraŋgiya umbwana ghen e maranɨna na maranɨna i manjamanjala amba valɨkaiwae ne u woraŋgiya ŋuthuŋuthuna ghanuna e marae.”
“Tha hu giya bigi boboma weŋgiya mbughambugha, ne iwaeŋge thɨ ndevɨ na thɨ gharɨŋga. Tha hu wokiyathu lemi bigi thovuye mbombo e ghamwanji, ne thɨ vurɨghɨya.”
Naŋgo, tamwe na dɨghɨdɨghɨ utuninji
“Hu naŋgo weya Loi na i giya weŋga; hu tamwe na hu vaidi; hu dɨghɨdɨghɨ na thɨnɨmba i vu weŋga.
Kaiwae thela thoŋgo i naŋgowe ne i wo, thela thoŋgo i tamwe ne i vaidi, na thela thoŋgo i dɨghɨdɨghɨ thɨnɨmba ne i mavuwe.”
“Ŋgoroŋga, thoŋgo ghemina regha nariye i naŋgo ghanɨŋgawe, ne i wogiya varɨwe?
O thoŋgo i naŋgo weya borogi, ne i giya mwatawe?

Othembe gharɨgharɨ raraithara ghemi, ko iyemaeŋge mbaŋake wolaghɨye hu giyagiya bigibigi thovuthovuye weŋgiya lemi ŋgaŋga. Iya kaiwae ra ghareghare wagiyawe, Ramanda e buruburu i giya bigibigi thovuthovuye weŋgiya thavala thɨ naŋgowe.”
“Budakaiya nuwamiya gharɨgharɨ thɨ vakatha e ghemi, hu vakathava weŋgi kaiwae Mosese le mbaro na Loi ghalɨŋae gharautu lenji vavaghare ŋgoreiya iyako.”
Kamwathɨ theghewo
“Hu ru e ghamba runa iya i mbɨmbɨthana, kaiwae Gehena ghaghamba ru i magaga na ghakamwathɨ i laghɨye, na gharɨgharɨ lemoyo thɨ rakareŋawe.
Ko yawalɨ ghaghamba ru i mbɨmbɨtha na kamwathɨniye nasiye na thegheviye eŋge thɨ vaidi.”
Loi ghalɨŋae gharautu kwanɨkwan
“Hu njimbukikiŋga, gharɨgharɨ vavana ne thɨ utu kwanɨkwan, ne thɨŋava thiye Loi ghalɨŋae gharautuŋgi. Ghanjiyamoyamo ne ŋgoreiya sip udauda, ko iyemaeŋge e gharenjiko ŋgoreiya mbugha njamnjam.
Une tene hu thuweya ve raŋgi e lenji vakathako. Waen une mane vo vu e tatata tɨnetɨne, ae? Kopi une mane vo vu e kavwala, ae?
Tembe ŋgoreiyeva, umbwa thovuye ne i rau ne une thovuye na umbwa raitharɨ i rau ne une raitharɨ.
Umbwa thovuye ma valɨkaiwae une i tharɨ na umbwa raitharɨ ma valɨkaiwae une i thovuye.
The umbwa i rau na une ma i thovuye, thɨ kitenɨyathu na thɨ bigiŋambu e ndɨghe une.
Ambane hu ghareghareŋgi e lenji vakathaŋgi.”
Thɨnɨvairɨ weŋgiya thavala ma thɨ ghambu Loi
“Ma gharɨgharɨke wolaghɨye iya thɨ dageke e ghino, ‘Giya, Giya,’ ne thɨ rakaruvao Loi ele ghamba mbaro tɨne, ko thela i vakatha ŋgoreiya Bwebwe e buruburu le renuwaŋa iye ne ve ru.
Mbaŋa ele ghambako gharɨgharɨ lemoyo ne thɨŋa ‘Giya, Giya, e idan wo utuŋa Loi ghalɨŋae, e idan woŋa na nyao raraitharɨ thɨ rakaraŋgi na e idan wo vakathaŋgiya vakatha ghamba rotaele laghɨlaghɨye.’
Amba ne ya dage weŋgi, ‘Ma ya ghareghareŋga. Hu roiteteŋgo, ghemi tharɨ gharavakatha.’”
Ŋgolo gharavatavatad theghewo
“Iya kaiwae thela i loŋweya lo utuke na i vakatha ŋgoreiye, iye ŋgoreiya amalama le renuwaŋama va i thovuye na i vatada le ŋgoloma e varɨ vwatae.
Uyevwelaghɨ i nja, ŋgonuŋgo i voru na ndewendewe i rowo vurɨgheghe e ŋgoloko iyako, ko iyemaeŋge mava i mambun kaiwae va i vatad e varɨ vwatae.
Ko thela i loŋweya lo utuke na ma i vakatha ŋgoreiye, iye ŋgoreiya amalama le renuwaŋama mava i thovuye na i vatada le ŋgoloma e kerakera vwatae.
Uyevwelaghɨ i nja, ŋgonuŋgo i voru na ndewendewe i rowo vurɨgheghe e ŋgoloko iyako, i mambun na laiye laghɨye moli.”
Mbaŋa Jisas i utuvao utuutuke thiyake, le vavaghareko kaiwae i wo gharɨgharɨ nuwanji.
Le vavaghare ma ŋgoreiya mbaro gharavavaghare, kaiwae i vavaghare weiye mbaro.
